title: Domtoren
blurb: The Dom Tower of Utrecht, built 1321 to 1382: at 112.3 m the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, freestanding since the cathedral nave collapsed in 1674.

systems.name: Base and entrance
systems.description: Plinth, entrance steps and the tall entrance portal in the south face.

systems.name: Lower shaft
systems.description: The tall lower square block with corner lesenes, chapel and guard windows, and string courses. No visible buttresses.

systems.name: Main cornice
systems.description: The deep cornice marking the transition from the lower block to the belfry.

systems.name: Belfry
systems.description: The upper square block with tall arched bell openings, clock faces and the 50-bell carillon.

systems.name: Lantern
systems.description: The much lighter open lantern crowning the tower, with piers, arches and pinnacles.

systems.name: Crown
systems.description: Spirelet, orb and weathercock at 112.3 m.
